build_resnet152_image_encoder: build a ResNet152 image encoder with configurable pooling and pretrained weights for visual feature extraction
build_transformer_text_encoder: build a BERT-based transformer text encoder with configurable hidden size and attention heads for NLP tasks
build_frcnn_image_encoder: build a Faster R-CNN image encoder with pretrained weights and configurable max detections for object detection
build_vit_encoder: build a Vision Transformer encoder with pretrained HuggingFace weights for image feature extraction
build_multimodal_encoder: build a multi-modal encoder combining image and text encoders with configurable modal and text hidden sizes
